engineering_answer: YES: the fixed eight-source, 276-frame development slice ran end-to-end with complete deployable same-frame spatial outputs.
cost_answer: 212.0172 charged GPU seconds (0.0589 h), 9070 MiB monitored peak, 141166 remote bytes added by the GPU run.
quality_answer: NOT DETERMINABLE beyond sparse weak diagnostics: only 11 frames in six source groups have coincident 9:16 weak ROI labels, and there is no eligible 16:9 quality reference.

priority.basis: Engineering is complete, while quality evidence is the binding gate. Existing P1b 16:9 media are identity-traceable but unannotated and lack a per-video licence grant in the project audit.
On this fixed slice, weak temporal macro F1 is 0.4653, two of eight videos have zero temporal overlap, and comparable ordered endpoints have 1.222 s mean and 4.0133 s maximum absolute error.

The spatial arm is complete and its six-group sparse weak mean IoU is 0.8614 versus 0.7338 for center, but the sample is too sparse for a model-selection claim. The prior 16-source space LoRA regressed and remains stopped.
